name: Padmalaya Telefilms Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Padmalaya Telefilms Ltd is engaged in the business of Film Production and Distribution.
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1]
Company provides facilities in the         production and post-production of Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada movies with network  of film distribution at major centers in India  and Film Exhibition network in Andhra Pradesh. Company has produced many popular tele-vision programs, serials telecast in various popular channels.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.62 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -1.23% over last 3 years.
